::: {.callout-note}
## Coming soon
Later tutorials will use the cluster from the **command line** — logging in over
SSH, loading modules, editing files, and submitting batch jobs with **Slurm**.
This page will be expanded then. For now, use the [JupyterLab](jupyterlab.qmd)
portal, which already gives you a terminal (**File ▸ New ▸ Terminal**).
:::

## Preview: logging in over SSH

Once command-line access is introduced, you will connect with:

```bash
ssh <your-username>@<login-host>   # login host will be posted with this task
```

using the same username and password you created during
[Registration](registration.qmd).

::: {.content-visible when-profile="solutions"}
